# ActiveInferenceEdgeLoop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop control framework where edge devices use free energy minimization to select actions that reduce prediction error, integrating perception and actuation. Provides a principled, energy-aware mechanism for neuromorphic edge nodes to autonomously adapt to environmental changes, a core iNEST requirement.
